svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a container whose sub-tasks are all but three done; beat 1: you tick its last open sub-tasks → the container completes itself — ring 4/4, title struck through — nobody ticked the parent; beat 2: you toggle one done sub-task back open → the container reopens — ring 3/4
